name: EXM_EMAIL_RECEIPT_IMPORT
description: This table contains receipt details retrieved from an email server that were emailed by users to create expense items for expense reports.

columns.name: EMAIL_RECEIPT_ID
columns.description: Primary key that locates email receipts.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: FROM_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Email address of the person who sent the electronic receipt.

columns.name: NOTIFY_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Email address of an employee who will receive the notifications for expense creation from the electronic receipt.

columns.name: TO_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Email addresses of the To-recipients on the electronic receipt email sent by the merchant.

columns.name: CC_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Email addresses of the recipients copied on the electronic receipt email sent by the merchant.

columns.name: EMAIL_CONTENT
columns.description: Email content received by the email server from the sender.

columns.name: PRE_IDR_PROCESSED_EMAIL
columns.description: Email content that is processed before it is sent it to Intelligent Document Recognition for parsing.

columns.name: IDR_RESPONSE
columns.description: Email content that is passed to a parsing engine where its response is stored as a collection of character data known as a Character Large Object.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Code that describes the status of the email that was received by the server.

columns.name: DOWNLOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Request identifier of the process that imports data from the email server and loads it to the database.

columns.name: PROCESSING_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Request identifier of the process that relays email content to Intelligent Document Recognition for parsing.

columns.name: CREATION_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Request identifier of the process that attempts to create an expense by parsing the output from Intelligent Document Recognition.

columns.name: REJECT_REASON
columns.description: Processing reason the email was rejected.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the person who sent the email.

columns.name: EXPENSE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the expense item that was created in response to the email that the user sent to the mail server.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_EXPENSE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the prior expense created for the same trip.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the email sent to the mail server.

columns.name: EMAIL_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the email was received by the mail server.

columns.name: EMAIL_SUBJECT
columns.description: Subject of the email sent to the mail server.

columns.name: EXPENSE_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the expense was incurred.
